_about: The one place for the site's look and names. Colors are 6-digit hex, or the name of another color here ('brand') to reuse it. Edit this, then run: python3 tools/make_brand.py. Then run the tests (python3 tests/run.py brand); they check that text and map dots stay readable.
name: Spokane in Progress
credit: Produced by Anthony Gill, writer of Spokane Rising.

logo._about: main is the primary logo (solid teal square), used in the headers, icons and every drawn image since issue #42; secondary is the framed version, kept for reference. Rebuild these from brand/source with tools/trace_logo.py; then tools/make_icons.py draws the favicon and app icons from them.

browser._about: Color names from 'colors' below. themeColor tints the phone browser's address bar; backgroundColor shows while the site opens as an app.

fonts._about: Chosen Nov. 27, 2026 (issue #42): Merriweather serif for headlines and reading lines over Libre Franklin for data and controls, as at The Economist, The Upshot and the FT. 'webfonts' loads them on the site; 'imageFonts' are the files the share-card drawer embeds (npm packages).

display.use: Headlines: the site name, project names, the headline sentence, page and section heads.

deck.use: Reading lines under headlines: the tagline, the stage summary, page intros, project summaries.

sans.use: Everything read as data or interface, including big numbers and chart titles.

scale._about: Every font size on the site (issue #42). styles.css uses only these, as var(--fs-NAME); the tests check. Roles, small to large.

2xs.use: Dense ticks and tags only: stage-track labels, est. markers, axis ticks.

xs.use: Small uppercase labels, source notes, map attribution.

sm.use: Notes, captions, counts, secondary lines in lists and menus.

ui.use: Controls, list details, tables, most interface text.

body.use: Running text and phone form fields (16px stops iPhones zooming in).

lead.use: Article body on About and Glossary; small headlines.

deck.use: Serif reading lines: tagline, headline sentence, project summaries.

intro.use: Page intros under a page headline.

h3.use: Project names in the list; small heads.

h1.use: Project page names; page titles in the small header.

title.use: The site name on the map page.

display.use: Page headlines on Stats, About and Glossary.

brand.use: Spokane Rising teal. Logo; the site's accent from phase 2 on.

ink.use: Body text, headlines, rules, chart axes.

paper.use: Page background: between cream and white.

paper-2.use: Hover and selected rows; locator land on cards.

link.use: Links, focus ring, Near circle on the map.

accent.use: Top rule and kickers. Pressed and selected controls are ink, not teal (issue #42).

chart.use: Single-series chart marks (middle housing, shares). Never a stage color.

surface.use: Menus, fields, buttons, white edges on map dots.

other.use: 'Other' category in charts; outline of the city on cards.

locator-hood.use: The project's neighborhood on share cards.

track-off.use: Stages not yet reached on the share-card track.
